description:
The Vyasakabi Fakir Mohan Bhasabruti Scholarship is a significant initiative launched by the Government of Odisha. 

This scholarship was introduced in 2016. 

It aims to provide financial assistance to students pursuing higher education in Odisha. 

The scholarship is named after the renowned poet and writer Fakir Mohan Senapati. 

He is often referred to as the father of modern Odia literature. 

The scholarship seeks to honor his contributions to literature and education. 

The primary objective of the Vyasakabi Fakir Mohan Bhasabruti Scholarship is to promote higher education among students from economically weaker sections. 

The government aims to increase the enrollment rate in higher education institutions. 

The scholarship specifically targets students who are pursuing undergraduate and postgraduate courses. 

Students enrolled in professional courses are also eligible for this scholarship. 

The scholarship provides a financial assistance of INR 10,000 per year. 

This amount is intended to cover various educational expenses. 

Eligible students can use the funds for tuition fees, books, and other academic-related costs. 

The scholarship is available to students who are residents of Odisha. 

To qualify for the scholarship, students must have a minimum percentage of 50% in their previous qualifying examination. 

This requirement ensures that the scholarship supports academically capable students. 

The income limit for applicants is set at INR 2.5 lakh per annum. 

This criterion aims to assist students from low-income families. 

The scholarship is applicable to students from all disciplines. 

This includes arts, science, commerce, engineering, and medical fields. 

The application process for the Vyasakabi Fakir Mohan Bhasabruti Scholarship is straightforward. 

Students must apply online through the official scholarship portal of the Government of Odisha. 

The application form requires personal details, educational qualifications, and income information. 

Students must upload necessary documents such as their previous examination mark sheets. 

They also need to provide proof of income. 

A caste certificate is required for students belonging to Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, or Other Backward Classes. 

The application window typically opens in July each year. 

Students are advised to submit their applications before the deadline, which is usually in August. 

The scholarship amount is disbursed directly into the bank accounts of the beneficiaries. 

Disbursement usually occurs within two months of the application deadline. 

The implementing authority for this scholarship is the Department of Higher Education, Government of Odisha. 

Students can contact the department for any queries related to the scholarship. 

The contact details for the Department of Higher Education can be found on their official website. 

The government has allocated a budget of INR 10 crore for this scholarship scheme in the financial year 2023-2024. 

The scholarship has benefited thousands of students since its inception. 

In the academic year 2022-2023, approximately 15,000 students received the scholarship. 

The government aims to increase this number in subsequent years. 

The Vyasakabi Fakir Mohan Bhasabruti Scholarship is part of a broader initiative to enhance educational opportunities in Odisha. 

The state government has launched various schemes to support students in recent years. 

These initiatives include financial aid, skill development programs, and vocational training. 

The scholarship is a crucial step towards achieving educational equity. 

It empowers students from disadvantaged backgrounds to pursue their academic goals. 

The government encourages eligible students to take advantage of this opportunity. 

The scholarship not only alleviates financial burdens but also motivates students to excel in their studies. 

Students are encouraged to maintain good academic performance to continue receiving the scholarship in subsequent years. 

The Vyasakabi Fakir Mohan Bhasabruti Scholarship reflects the commitment of the Odisha government to promote education. 

It aims to create a more educated and skilled workforce in the state. 

The scholarship is a testament to the government's recognition of the importance of education in social and economic development. 

Students are urged to stay updated on any changes to the scholarship scheme. 

They should regularly check the official website for announcements and updates. 

The government also conducts awareness programs to inform students about the scholarship. 

These programs are held in various educational institutions across the state. 

The Vyasakabi Fakir Mohan Bhasabruti Scholarship is a vital resource for students in Odisha. 

It plays a significant role in reducing dropout rates in higher education. 

By providing financial support, the government aims to encourage students to complete their degrees. 

The scholarship also contributes to the overall development of the state. 

It fosters a culture of learning and academic excellence among the youth. 

The Vyasakabi Fakir Mohan Bhasabruti Scholarship is a commendable initiative. 

It embodies the spirit of empowerment through education. 

The government of Odisha continues to strive for inclusive education. 

This scholarship is one of the many steps taken towards achieving that goal. 

Eligible students should not miss the opportunity to apply for this scholarship. 

It can significantly impact their educational journey and future prospects. 

The Vyasakabi Fakir Mohan Bhasabruti Scholarship is a beacon of hope for many aspiring students in Odisha. 

It stands as a symbol of the state's commitment to education and social welfare. 

Students are encouraged to take proactive steps in their educational pursuits. 

The scholarship is designed to support them in overcoming financial challenges. 

The government remains dedicated to enhancing the educational landscape in Odisha. 

The Vyasakabi Fakir Mohan Bhasabruti Scholarship is a vital part of that vision. 

In conclusion, the scholarship offers substantial benefits to eligible students. 

It is an essential tool for promoting higher education in Odisha. 

Students are urged to apply and make the most of this opportunity.
